song_title: Angara - Forgive You (feat. Ingrid Lukas) (Extended Version)
thesis: Translate forgiveness into light by evolving from dark river-blue tension toward warm amber release, using patient flow and widening space to signal emotional acceptance.

artist_branding.summary: Angara and Ingrid Lukas read as emotional melodic-house storytelling: intimate darkness, patient builds, and voice-led warmth emerging gradually from deep nocturnal palettes.
visual_cues: Water-like sweep paths and gentle long-arc transitions
Late-night blue/teal base with selective human warmth highlights
Bridge valleys that collapse intensity before earned euphoric reopenings
do_not_copy: Do not imitate any single festival edit staging or signature one-to-one cueing from published live videos.

motifs: Geometry motif: inward-to-outward sweeps that widen as tension dissolves
Color motif: midnight blue to ocean teal, then amber and soft gold at emotional unlocks
Movement motif: patient 4-8 beat arcs in valleys, tighter 2-beat propulsion in drops

visual_direction.color_story: Maintain deep blue and teal through intro and valley, then blend amber and soft gold as the vocal perspective resolves into release.
visual_direction.motion_story: Design movement as flowing current: broad arcs during introspection, expanding width and pace only when sub and vocal confidence return.
visual_direction.staging_story: Use center and DJ-focused intimacy in low sections, then spread to SL/SR/X/US zones during drop peaks to represent emotional opening.

must_include: At least one near-black bridge pocket with single-fixture emotional focus
Water-like mover route continuity rather than hard angular chopping
Drop sections must show measurable position-width expansion versus intro
avoid: Aggressive nonstop strobe blocks that fight the vocal narrative
Cold-only palette in vocal release phrases
Busy per-bar motif switching that obscures long-form story
